narrationTexts: Confirmed the two real bugs. Now fixing both call sites.
finalText:
**Build is clean. Exit 0, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw `TypeError` on `.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) treated unset flags as invalid. New config loader leaves them `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw. Now `undefined` maps to `disabled`.

The rest was deprecation noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc), harmless.

Next: nothing.
